content.text: {"title":"The Template That Knew Its Parent","premise":"A web page is two files: a layout with holes in it, and a member list that fills the holes. Jinja's job is to turn that pair of strings into one correct, injection-safe HTML document — and to do it fast enough to be worth caching. The story follows one string, the source of `members.html`, from the moment a DictLoader hands it over, through lexing, parsing, code generation and `exec`, until it comes back as rendered HTML with an ampersand safely escaped. Along the way it passes every decision an owner has to vouch for: what gets cached and when it goes stale, when the autoescape question is actually asked, what the generated Python is allowed to do, and who decides which file a template may pull in.","chapters":[{"n":1,"title":"The World It Enters","trace_lines":[2,17],"data_in":"mapping={'base.html': '…', 'members.html': '{% extends \"base.html\" %}…'}, autoescape=select_autoescape(['html','htm','xml'])","data_out":"a configured Environment: loader=DictLoader, cache=LRUCache(400), extensions={}, is_async=False, autoescape=.autoescape>","code":["src/jinja2/loaders.py:432-453","src/jinja2/environment.py:295-370","src/jinja2/environment.py:83-142"],"inputs":["the two template sources in scenario.py","select_autoescape(['html','htm','xml'])"],"characters":["DictLoader","select_autoescape's closure","Environment.__init__","create_cache","LRUCache","load_extensions","_environment_config_check"],"facts":["`autoescape` arrives as a callable, not a bool; the constructor's own default is `False` (environment.py:313), so escaping is opt-in and here it is opted into by name pattern.","`cache_size=400` becomes an `LRUCache(400)`; `0` disables template caching entirely and a negative size gives an unbounded dict (environment.py:83-93).","`auto_reload` defaults to `True`, so a cached template will be re-checked against its uptodate function before reuse.","`bytecode_cache` is None, so every template miss costs a full parse and compile in-process.","`_environment_config_check` uses `assert` for its invariants (undefined must subclass Undefined, delimiters must differ) — those checks disappear under `python -O`.","`load_extensions(env, ())` returns `{}`: in this run no extension can preprocess the source or rewrite the token stream."],"open_questions":[{"id":"q1.1","question":"The autoescape callable has been stored but never called. Who asks it whether 'members.html' should be escaped, and when?"}],"answers":[]},{"n":2,"title":"Asked For By Name","trace_lines":[18,28],"data_in":"Environment.get_template(name='members.html', parent=None, globals=None)","data_out":"the raw source `'{% extends \"base.html\" %}\\n{% block t…'`, filename None, and an uptodate lambda, handed to Environment.compile","code":["src/jinja2/environment.py:980-1015","src/jinja2/environment.py:955-978","src/jinja2/environment.py:1110-1130","src/jinja2/loaders.py:107-149","src/jinja2/loaders.py:444-450"],"inputs":["template name 'members.html'"],"characters":["Environment.get_template","Environment._load_template","LRUCache.get","weakref.ref(loader)","Environment.make_globals","BaseLoader.load","DictLoader.get_source"],"facts":["`parent is None`, so `join_path` is skipped and the caller's name goes straight to the loader — the name is the whole authorisation check.","The cache key is `(weakref.ref(self.loader), name)`: two loaders cannot collide, and entries die with their loader.","`make_globals` returns `ChainMap({}, env.globals)`, so per-template globals can never mutate the environment's globals.","`BaseLoader.load` calls `get_source` first and only then considers the bytecode cache; with no bytecode cache the source is compiled every time it is loaded.","`DictLoader.get_source` returns `filename=None`; tracebacks for this template will say `
